## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, the previous behavior and the result of this change.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Note any unavailable environments.
For report changes, include relevant browser engines and a synthetic screenshot.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to CLI options, manifest/snapshot formats, paths or replacement behavior.
Link updated documentation and migration instructions where applicable.

- [ ] Changes have focused regression coverage where behavior or invariants changed.
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented in both READMEs and the changelog as needed.
- [ ] Fixtures contain synthetic data; generated reports and private source are excluded.
